primary_population: patients eligible in both T_cell and Myeloid at both timepoints
normalization: lineage-specific pseudobulk log2(CPM+0.5), followed by response-blind gene-wise z scoring
module_score: mean z score of measured genes in each frozen module and its frozen target lineage
family_score: unweighted mean of all 16 frozen module scores
primary_effect: mean patient delta in RE minus mean patient delta in NR
primary_test: two-sided exhaustive permutation of patient response labels with fixed group sizes
global_shift_sensitivity: HC3 response coefficient adjusted for response-blind global-expression PC1 delta
random_control_matching: measured locked genes replaced one-to-one within response-blind detectability deciles; one replacement map is reused across modules to preserve gene overlap
primary_success_gates: direction concordance of z-score and rank-score families
prohibited: exclusion without a source-defined quality or regimen reason
using cells, genes or modules as independent response replicates
suppressing a null or opposite result
